first_step_test: One large bold disc fixes the yo-yo scale and leaves open space above for the string; a learner can copy it without hidden construction.

source.notes: First three sheets rejected for disappearing mark, early color, or repeated-element count. Fourth six-panel felt-tip sheet approved after complete saved-crop review.

final_elements.name: round yo-yo face
final_elements.description: One large circular front disc tilted slightly right, in final position.

final_elements.name: side rim and center hub
final_elements.description: Thick lower-right side rim and small center hub fixed within front disc.

final_elements.name: looping string
final_elements.description: One continuous black line anchored at the top of the yo-yo, rising into a single large loop to the upper left.

final_elements.name: motion marks
final_elements.description: Exactly two short curved motion strokes outside the left disc edge and one small four-point sparkle high right.

final_elements.name: face bands and ground
final_elements.description: Four curved divider arcs from outer circle to central hub, making four alternating color sectors, and one broken ground shadow.

frames.visible_job: With a black felt-tip marker, draw one bold round yo-yo face tilted slightly right, leaving open paper above it for the string.
frames.instruction: With a black felt-tip marker, draw one bold round yo-yo face tilted slightly right, leaving open paper above it for the string.

frames.visible_job: Echo a narrow side rim along the lower-right edge of the circle, then place one small round hub at its center.
frames.instruction: Echo a narrow side rim along the lower-right edge of the circle, then place one small round hub at its center.

frames.visible_job: From the top of the yo-yo, pull one thin string upward and curl it into one large open loop to the upper left.
frames.instruction: From the top of the yo-yo, pull one thin string upward and curl it into one large open loop to the upper left.

frames.visible_job: Outside the disc, draw exactly two short curved motion marks on the left and one small four-point sparkle high to the right.
frames.instruction: Outside the disc, draw exactly two short curved motion marks on the left and one small four-point sparkle high to the right.

frames.visible_job: Inside the disc, draw four curved divider arcs from the outer edge to the central hub, making four sectors. Below the yo-yo, put one broken shadow.
frames.instruction: Inside the disc, draw four curved divider arcs from the outer edge to the central hub, making four sectors. Below the yo-yo, put one broken shadow.

final_step.visible_job: Add bright marker fills within existing disc bands and hub; retain all contours.
final_step.instruction: Let the black ink dry. Fill the established disc bands coral and teal, the hub yellow, and the rim deep navy. Leave small paper streaks in the marker fill.

visual_review.first_step_observation: Saved first crop shows one large black marker circle in the lower middle of its square; the clean interior leaves room for the center hub and four sectors.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: The six saved square crops retain one disc, central hub and right rim. A single textured string loop stays attached at top, two left motion strokes and one right sparkle persist, and four arcs meet the hub before final color. No temporary guides appear; final adds color on existing sectors without moving contours.

transitions.observed_addition: The round disc remains fixed; a narrow right-hand side rim and one centered hub circle appear.
transitions.instruction_match: The second instruction describes the right rim and small hub.

transitions.observed_addition: The disc, rim and hub remain; a single textured string begins at twelve o’clock and loops upper left.
transitions.instruction_match: The third instruction names the top anchor and loop direction.

transitions.observed_addition: The same disc and string stay fixed; exactly two separated curved marks appear left of the disc and one four-point sparkle appears upper right.
transitions.instruction_match: The fourth instruction matches both left strokes and the single right sparkle.

transitions.observed_addition: All earlier landmarks remain; four curved arcs connect the disc edge to the hub and a broken shadow appears below.
transitions.instruction_match: The fifth instruction matches four arc connections and new ground strokes.

transitions.observed_addition: The disc, rim, hub, string, two motion marks, sparkle, four arcs and ground shadow stay in place; coral and teal fill the four sectors, yellow fills hub and navy fills rim.
transitions.instruction_match: The finish instruction fills established regions and adds no contour.
